composition.serve_who: This sheet is the 230V AC AFT DISTRIBUTION PANEL (GMMS 108'-102a): three incoming 230V AC feeds (AFT OUTLETS, GALLEY 1, GALLEY 2), each protected by its own earth-leakage breaker, feeding two breaker columns — Q1-Q6 (galley appliances: oven, dishwasher, washing machine, dryer, steam oven, zip water dispenser) and Q7-Q17 (maserator/sink disposal, diving compressor, wine cooler galley, galley extractor outlets, nav station outlets, port/stbd crew outlets with primary ventilation, lazarette outlets, blast chiller, two spare/unlabelled ways, induction hob). Each named load row is served by the equipment that load names; the panel structure itself (incoming feeds, earth-leakage breakers, bus/rail topology) belongs to the aft AC distribution infrastructure, not to any single appliance.

infrastructure.system_name: 230V AC Aft Distribution Panel — incoming feeds and earth-leakage protection
facts: Three incoming 230V AC feeds enter the panel: AFT OUTLETS, GALLEY 1, GALLEY 2, each shown with a 16mm² wire-gauge callout on both conductors.
AFT OUTLETS feed passes through EARTH LEAKAGE 1 breaker before distribution (breaker device_id not legible/labelled beyond 'EARTH LEAKAGE 1').

GALLEY 1 feed passes through EARTH LEAKAGE 2 breaker; netlist confirms EARTH LEAKAGE 2 shares nets with 16 (wire gauge), Q1-Q4 and a relay-contact-labelled node (net8), indicating GALLEY 1's earth-leakage output is the common rail feeding the Q1-Q4 breaker bank.

GALLEY 2 feed passes through EARTH LEAKAGE 3 breaker; netlist shows EARTH LEAKAGE 3 on nets with 16, GALLEY 1 and GALLEY 2 wire-gauge nodes (net12/13/39/40/42), and net12 also includes Q6 — GALLEY 2's earth-leakage output feeds Q6 among others.
Common rail net8 (unlabelled) ties together EARTH LEAKAGE 2, Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4 and a relay-contact device — this is the shared bus feeding the Q1-Q4 breaker group, not a private feed per breaker.
Two breaker ways (labelled Q15/Q16 on the sheet, drawn as '/' with no load name) are SPARE ways reserved for future loads — not equipment functions.
Panel identity: GMMS 108'-102a, '230V AFT DISTRIBUTION PANEL', drawn 4/10/2023 by GM for project SWS 108'-01 'Gelliceaux', customer Southern Wind Shipyard (PTY) LTD.
